task_title: Icon batch generation pipeline (CLI + GH Actions + canvas)

plan_review.notes: 5 blocking concerns found: (1) brief generators emitted variantCount (not a schema field) and did not set generation.sheet.emptyCells for partial batches; (2) approveIconBatch index mapping unsafe if pipeline drops cells; (3) approval bypassed quality gates - documented as known gap, count guard added; (4) runtime lookup model gap - documented in handoff as consumer-side follow-on; (5) issue body parsing used raw contains() checks instead of form-markdown parsing. All 5 blocking concerns addressed. Plan divergence: minor - no re-architecture, only bug fixes to existing design.
